verdict.rationale: Make documents an official TypeScript SDK on its client-libraries page, with type definitions, built-in error handling and response typing over most endpoints of its documented REST API. AI-native users can build against it directly. missing for 10: SDKs beyond TypeScript (no Python or other languages evidenced), coverage of all API endpoints rather than a majority, a public OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDK.
